sourceNotes.referenceTitle: Anti Tarnish Gold Ball Charm Bracelet for Women
sourceNotes.rawContent: Meet your new everyday favourite — a delicate gold chain bracelet adorned with dangling ball charms that catch the light beautifully. Adjustable lobster clasp ensures a perfect fit for all wrist sizes. Anti-tarnish finish keeps it looking brand new, from casual brunches to festive occasions.
